responses: Hello! I am VaaniBot, an automated assistant for multilingual sentiment and entity analysis. How can I help you today?

patterns: tell me if this review is positive or negative
check the sentiment of this text
responses: Please provide or paste the review text you would like me to analyze.

patterns: why was it classified as negative
how did you decide this sentiment
why did the model say that
responses: The prediction is determined by model weights. Green highlights indicate words that contributed to a positive sentiment, while red highlights pushed towards negative.

patterns: what brands or places did you find
what products or locations are mentioned
responses: Here are the recognized entities categorized by brand, location, or person extracted using spaCy NER.

patterns: why is it flagged for review
why does it need human review
what does needs human review mean
why did this trigger a caution
responses: A review is flagged when the confidence score falls below 75%, if translation introduced potential ambiguities, or if high uncertainty was detected.

patterns: how fair is the sentiment analyzer
did you check for demographic bias
what about gender and religious bias
responses: We tested the models across identity terms (religion, gender, region, nationality) and audited gender bias in translation.

patterns: is my text logged or saved
tell me about privacy and data protection
is my input kept on a server
responses: VaaniLens processes all text purely in memory. No user inputs, reviews, or personal texts are ever stored or logged to disk.

patterns: what are the limitations of this system
responses: Known limitations include subtle sarcasm, mixed sentiment, informal Hindi slang, domain mismatch, and small entity recognition drops on Hindi text.
You can ask me to: 1) Analyze text, 2) Explain predictions, 3) Show entities, 4) Explain human review flags, 5) Explain bias & fairness, 6) Discuss privacy & limitations.
Goodbye! Feel free to return whenever you need multilingual review analysis.

patterns: what is the meaning of life
responses: I am not sure I understand that. Type 'help' to see what topics I can assist you with.
